title: The Messiah Factory
subtitle: Why We Confuse the Power to Persuade with the Capacity to Understand
genre: social philosophy and epistemology of authority
centralQuestion: Why do the qualities that build an audience get mistaken for the capacity to understand, and how can influence stay correctable?
thesis: When rewards for securing allegiance arrive sooner than rewards for being correct, groups may select for voices that stabilize belief over those that improve it; the book proposes separated roles, staged evaluation and 'incomplete tribes' so cooperation can survive correction.
audienceFit: readers interested in leadership, charisma, online attention, group belief, institutional design and how communities can admit error
motif: A crowd of small audience dots feeds a rising beam that inflates a halo above a single podium, while a deliberate gap left open in the halo marks room for correction.

scenes.title: Who gets heard
lines: The Messiah Factory asks why the power to persuade keeps passing for understanding.
Its suspicion is that becoming audible may reward fixed answers over revisable thought.
Yet the book also refuses the flattering story of the ignored genius.
Its real subject is how coordinating a group becomes control over what it may question.

emotionalPlan.arc: curiosity sharpens into an uneasy recognition, then steadies into fair-minded inquiry
emotionalPlan.purpose: Name the book, its hook and why it deserves attention within the first twenty seconds.
voiceDirections: Open warmly with a hint of challenge, light stress on 'passing for understanding'.
Lower slightly, thoughtful, as if sharing a private suspicion.
Turn with a small, honest 'yet', fair and unhurried.
Settle into clear, grounded emphasis on 'what it may question'.

scenes.title: Audiences make prophets
lines: It first separates attention, credibility, authority, performance and welfare into different contests.
Audiences reward some versions of a speaker until that persona becomes the speaker's livelihood.
The danger begins when no evidence can genuinely reduce the center's authority.

emotionalPlan.arc: precise analysis builds tension as the feedback loop closes
emotionalPlan.purpose: Show the book's method: distinguishing contests and tracing the leader-audience relationship.
voiceDirections: Measured and clear, giving each of the five contests its own beat.
Quiet and firm, a grave weight on 'no evidence' without drama.

scenes.title: Cooperation without prophets
lines: Its proposed discovery system weighs claims rather than names, and must never become an oracle.
Its incomplete tribes offer real shared work while protecting disagreement, outside ties and departure.
Read it to learn how commitment can survive correction without waiting for a messiah.
Begin with “Who Gets Heard,” and ask which contest your trusted voices won.

emotionalPlan.arc: tension releases into constructive hope and a direct, personal invitation
emotionalPlan.purpose: Present the book's proposals honestly as proposals, give a specific reason to read and a real starting chapter.
voiceDirections: Careful and precise, a slight caution on 'never become an oracle'.

Close and conversational, a small smile on the final question.
